notes.title: News about initial problems with the Metro2 The Stalin Subway release!
notes.notes:
Greetings,

We take into account all of your reviews, messages and discussions. That's why we would like to quell some of your worries about initial problems with the Metro2 The Stalin Subway release.

Download problem issue:
- We are very sorry for a bad experience you could have had. The problem was actually on a Steam side. It's fixed now and the game download works just fine .

Regarding Russian version:
- As it was a consequence of the Steam problem it's now fixed as well so you can enjoy the game in Russian. 

Many thanks for your feedbacks!

Sincerely yours,
BUKA Entertainment
